# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_obsidian_tech.py". Change the tables there and re-run.

# Fixed effects of the obsidian runes (general rune library). Called from DA_remove_Unique_Metallurgy_modifiers_runes.
DA_OBS_remove_library_rune_modifiers = {
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.defense.1
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.discipline.1
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.fire_damage.2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.fire_damage.3
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.land_attrition.2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.morale_damage.2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.morale_damage.3
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.morale_damage_received.2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.reinforce_speed.2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.reinforce_speed.3
	remove_country_modifier = DA_Unique_mod.RUNE.$DA_unit$.shock_damage.1
}

DA_PR_give_first.Obsidian_bp = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Unlocked.Obsidian_Glaive } }
		country_event = { id = DA_OBS_discovery.1 }
	}
}

}

# A school level as its study gives it: the flags of every level up to it, its modifier, and for Mechanics the
# innovation points of each level. A level the country already has is left alone.
DA_OBS_school_Alchemy_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Alchemy_2 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Alchemy_1
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Alchemy_2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Alchemy_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Alchemy_3
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Alchemy_4
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_Alchemy_2 duration = -1 }
	}
}
DA_OBS_school_Alchemy_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Alchemy_3 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Alchemy_1
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Alchemy_2
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Alchemy_3
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Alchemy_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Alchemy_2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Alchemy_4
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_Alchemy_3 duration = -1 }
	}
}
DA_OBS_school_Magic_Theory_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_2 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_1
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Arcane_Arts_1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Arcane_Arts_3
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Arcane_Arts_4
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_Arcane_Arts_2 duration = -1 }
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_4 } }
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_1
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_2
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_3
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Magic_Theory_4

DA_OBS_school_Mechanics_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_2 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_1 } } DA_gain_mechanics_inno_points_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_2 } } DA_gain_mechanics_inno_points_2 = yes }
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_1
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_2
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Mechanics_1_modifier
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Mechanics_3_modifier
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Mechanics_4_modifier
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_Mechanics_2_modifier duration = -1 }
	}
}
DA_OBS_school_Mechanics_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_3 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_1 } } DA_gain_mechanics_inno_points_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_2 } } DA_gain_mechanics_inno_points_2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_3 } } DA_gain_mechanics_inno_points_3 = yes }
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_1
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_2
		set_country_flag = DA_Project.completed.Mechanics_3
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Mechanics_1_modifier
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Mechanics_2_modifier
		remove_country_modifier = DA_Mechanics_4_modifier
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_Mechanics_3_modifier duration = -1 }
	}
}

# School levels by the year the arsenal arrives.
DA_OBS_grant_schools = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_year = 1600 } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_OBS_tt_schools_1
		hidden_effect = {
			DA_OBS_school_Mechanics_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Magic_Theory_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Alchemy_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Medicine_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Metallurgy_2 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_year = 1600 NOT = { is_year = 1650 } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_OBS_tt_schools_2
		hidden_effect = {
			DA_OBS_school_Mechanics_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Magic_Theory_3 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Alchemy_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Medicine_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Metallurgy_2 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_year = 1650 }
		custom_tooltip = DA_OBS_tt_schools_3
		hidden_effect = {
			DA_OBS_school_Mechanics_3 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Magic_Theory_4 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Alchemy_3 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Medicine_2 = yes
			DA_OBS_school_Metallurgy_3 = yes
		}
	}
}

# The Legion's infantry: Blackbarrel Volley Gun, Rune of Millennial Rancour, Mithril with Obsidian Forging. The designer's own effects, in the order a player picks the parts.
DA_OBS_legion_design_INFAN = {
	# reset, as the Reset button of Unit Design
	DA_initialize_metallurgy_variables = { DA_unit = INFAN }
	DA_remove_Unique_Metallurgy_modifiers_flags = { DA_unit = INFAN }
	remove_country_modifier = DA_metallurgy_infantry_modifier_fake
	# primary technology, blueprint, metal and rune, as the four choices of the designer and their after blocks
	DA_SCH_pick = { unit = INFAN part = punk token = Obsidian }
	DA_apply_Punk = {
		DA_unit = INFAN
		DA_Cost = 3
		DA_Strength = 1
		DA_Magic_Conductivity = 1
		DA_Electrical_Conductivity = 0
		DA_Unique = Obsidian
	}
	set_country_flag = DA_selected_punk_INFAN
	DA_SCH_pick = { unit = INFAN part = bp token = Obsidian_Volley_Gun }
	DA_apply_Blueprint = {
		DA_unit = INFAN
		DA_Cost = 11
		DA_RUNE_SLOTS = 1
		DA_power = 0.01
		DA_fire = 0.04
		DA_shock = 0.00
		DA_Fire_rec = -0.00
		DA_Shock_rec = -0.00
		DA_Unique = fire_damage.2
		DA_Magical = yes
		DA_power.Magical = 0.00
		DA_fire.Magical = 0.02
		DA_shock.Magical = 0.00
		DA_Fire_rec.Magical = -0.00
		DA_Shock_rec.Magical = -0.00
	}
	set_country_flag = DA_selected_blueprint_INFAN
	DA_SCH_pick = { unit = INFAN part = metal token = Mithril }
	DA_apply_Metal = {
		DA_unit = INFAN
		DA_Cost = 4
		DA_Strength = 3
		DA_Magic_Conductivity = 2
		DA_Electrical_Conductivity = 0
	}
	set_country_flag = DA_selected_metal_INFAN
	DA_SCH_pick_rune = { unit = INFAN token = Obsidian_Rune_Rancour }
	DA_apply_Runes = {
		DA_unit = INFAN
		DA_Cost = 5
		DA_power = 0.01
		DA_fire = 0.00
		DA_shock = 0.04
		DA_Fire_rec = -0.00
		DA_Shock_rec = -0.00
		DA_Unique = morale_damage.3
	}
	set_country_flag = DA_selected_INFAN_rune_1
	# finish, as Implement Unit Design and its event a year later (DA_Metallurgy_events.53 / 63 / 73)
	DA_remove_metallurgy_infcav_modifiers_effect = { DA_unit = INFAN }
	DA_remove_Unique_Metallurgy_modifiers = { DA_unit = INFAN }
	DA_pre_apply_metallurgy_modifiers = { DA_unit = INFAN }
	add_country_modifier = { name = DA_metallurgy_infantry_modifier_fake duration = -1 }
	DA_apply_metallurgy_infcav_modifiers_effect = { DA_unit = INFAN }
	DA_give_Unique_Metallurgy_modifiers = { DA_unit = INFAN }
	DA_OBS_class_cost = { DA_unit = INFAN }
}

# New Warforged regiments in the capital, as shares of the force limit.

	create_unit_forcelimit_percentage = { type = infantry special_unit_category = musketeer force_limit_percentage = 0.45 }
	create_unit_forcelimit_percentage = { type = cavalry special_unit_category = qizilbash force_limit_percentage = 0.10 }
	create_unit_forcelimit_percentage = { type = artillery special_unit_category = streltsy force_limit_percentage = 0.20 }
}

# The Forges Beneath (DA_OBS.1): everything the Legion gets.
DA_OBS_legion_arsenal = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_OBS_tt_steam
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_completed_Steam_power_project
		set_country_flag = DA_RS_Steam_power_enabled
	}
	DA_OBS_grant_schools = yes
	custom_tooltip = DA_OBS_tt_unlocks
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_OBS_unlock_all = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_can_apply_runes_to_metallurgy
		set_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System
		DA_enable_Metal_Infan = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_cav
		DA_enable_Metal_Caval = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_art
	}
	custom_tooltip = DA_OBS_tt_regiments
	hidden_effect = { DA_OBS_legion_regiments = yes }
	custom_tooltip = DA_OBS_tt_designs
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_OBS_legion_design_INFAN = yes
		DA_OBS_legion_design_CAVAL = yes
		DA_OBS_legion_design_ARTIL = yes
		clr_country_flag = DA_UNIT_DESIGN_IN_USE
	}
}
